questions.text: Which modules own user registration and what is each module's responsibility?
Which module handles the registration request for user registration?
Which modules validate personal information and the selected role, and manage role-specific data such as student ID or librarian identifier?
Which module verifies account validity and uniqueness and which module persists the newly created user for user registration?
What uses or containment relations connect the registration-owning modules so invalid or duplicate-user paths can be located as integration points?
